structuredState.content:
# Getting started

Install the client, then configure the endpoint you want to recieve events from.

## Events

Each subscriber will recieve a copy of every event published to its topic.
Events are delivered at least once; handlers must be idempotent.

## Errors

If you do not recieve an event within the timeout, the broker retries twice.
